"publication_id": "JP-S63187245-A", "title": "Waterless planographic original printing plate", "abstract": "PURPOSE:To permit dry processing of a titled printing original plate by incorporating microcapsules contg. silver halide, reducing agent and polymerizable compd. into a photosensitive layer. CONSTITUTION:This waterless planographic printing original plate is constituted by laminating the photosensitive layer contg. the microcapsules and silicone rubber layer successively on a base. The silver halide (e.g.: silver iodobromide), the reducing agent (e.g.: hydrazine deriv.), and the polymerizable compd. (e.g.: acrylate) are incorporated into the capsules. An org. silver salt (e.g.: benzotriazole silver emulsion) and thermal polymn. initiator (e.g.: azo compd.) are preferably incorporated into the capsules. After such printing original plate is exposed, the plate is developed by heating and is then heated and/or pressurized. A non-image part (ink repulsive part) where the capsules harden and the rubber layer exists in the state before the heating and an image part (ink receptive part) where the capsules soften and the polymerizable compd., etc., leach in the rubber layer are thereby formed.", "language": "en", "title_language": "en", "text_quality": "title_abstract", "text_hash": "481caf80b87cfa3f0b0786abc19c07acfa460f9f7f36449be864824b6eaf1dc3", "title_text_id": "76060cb867891528e696f0386083ac60818c13384f7eb4c68d8c22445500cbf7", "abstract_text_id": "0f738d7a5b5e0474227f84f2fbb2bfbc9f407fd1d9bb5e12c16706b4488a24bd", "source": "patents-public-data.patents.publications", "translated": null, "priority_date": "1987-01-29", "selection_role": "random", "center_cosine": 0.8664348721504211, "abstract_truncated": false}, {"row_idx": 92091, "family_id": "google:18581482", "pub_id": "JP2001249444A", "publication_id": "JP-2001249444-A", "title": "Negative type photosensitive planographic printing plate", "abstract": "PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a negative type photosensitive planographic printing plate excellent in the adhesiveness of a photosensitive layer to the substrate while maintaining superior sensitivity, photosensitive region and performance of the photosensitive layer. SOLUTION: In the original plates for planographic printing each with a hydrophilic photosensitive layer containing a photothermal converting agent and a hydrophobic precursor disposed on a substrate, the hydrophobic precursor contains organosilicon groups.", "language": "en", "title_language": "en", "text_quality": "title_abstract", "text_hash": "f77ec2092f1a5193770c949c54d2e766b67962f960455ff974d323ad5116b332", "title_text_id": "c7c84aa48cf70d0173515dd9decad46db18ffb55b960a7a1cd0c6de9704ddaf3", "abstract_text_id": "7ec5fe0377ae477bded6419bf9d9782aa12c021395f5a766742484bcf9573fb8", "source": "patents-public-data.patents.publications", "translated": null, "priority_date": "2000-06-19", "selection_role": "random", "center_cosine": 0.8769398927688599, "abstract_truncated": false}, {"row_idx": 82933, "family_id": "google:17927760", "pub_id": "unresolved:5e3f9b73f79f5373a41450b5", "publication_id": "JP-H04177254-A", "title": "Original plate for lithography", "abstract": "PURPOSE:To enable a copy image faithful to an original image to be reproduced, and the occurrence of plate surface contamination to be prevented by causing a plate surface layer to contain a specified mono-functional monomer and a graft copolymer as major ingredients. CONSTITUTION:A surface layer contains at least one of fluorine and silicon atoms. In addition, the layer contains a graft copolymer composed of a mono- functional polymer having a functional group generating at least one of a sulfor group, a phosphono group or the like via a decomposition process, and a mono- functional macro monomer having a weight average molecular weight of 2X10<4> or less bonding a polymeric double bonded group as per formula I only to one end of a polymer main chain containing at least one type of polymer ingredients expressed by the formulae II and III. In the formulae, X1 stands for -COO- or the like, a1 and a2 for a hydrogen atom, a cyano group or the like, X2 for the same as X1, and R1 for a fatty acid group having carbon atoms between 1 and 18 or an aromatic group having carbon atoms between 6 and 12. Also, b1 and b2 stand for the same as a1 and a2, and R2 for -CN- or the like.
